races.paceDynamic: Josh's Joy looks the lone committed early leader with Glory To Be, Reimagined, Staysound Susie, Varshini, Likedbymike, Asdana, Gloriously Glam, Tai Tam Bay and Bint Majestic Roi all showing prominent tendencies. This creates a competitive early pace across 6f on soft ground with multiple horses wanting to be handy. The substantial hold-up contingent of Rion Rubette, Nancy J, Oh Cecelia, Sarahmae, Goofy Gander and Aurora Nova will benefit from the strong gallop up front. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine with so many prominent runners and the field will be strung out for closers to pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade go too fast early trying to secure position
scenarios.body: The sustained pace over 6f on testing ground will find out the early pace-setters, allowing the back-markers to sweep up late. Fresh horses returning from breaks like Rion rubette and Aurora Nova can capitalize on the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Speed Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Josh's Joy or Glory To Be can dictate at a controlled tempo
scenarios.body: One of the handier horses gets first run on the field and the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the change of pace. Glory To Be's recent win on similar going and Staysound Susie's in-form stable give them the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with Josh's Joy going too slow
scenarios.body: Horses positioned just off the pace like Varshini and Likedbymike can quicken past tired leaders while avoiding the traffic problems that snare the hold-up horses. Colin Keane's booking of Likedbymike suggests stable confidence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform and an unconsidered runner finds the perfect trip
scenarios.body: A horse like Bint Majestic Roi gets the ideal run from her trainer-jockey combination or Tai Tam Bay's consistency on this trip pays dividends. The competitive nature of the handicap allows a bigger price to slip through.

races.paceDynamic: Totally Puzzled is the only confirmed front runner in this field, meaning she can control the tempo from the outset without pressure. With most runners carrying hold-up (H) or unknown (U) styles, the early pace will be moderate as the field settles behind the leader. The lack of pace pressure will allow Totally Puzzled to dictate comfortable fractions through the first mile before the soft ground tests stamina reserves in the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours prominent runners and early pace-setters — the uncontested lead creates a significant tactical advantage over hold-up horses who must make up ground on energy-sapping soft turf.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Totally Puzzled gets an easy lead and maintains her rhythm
scenarios.body: The soft ground will blunt late kicks while she controls every call, stretching clear when Colin Keane asks. Her previous course form and prominent style perfectly suit these conditions where making up ground is difficult.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Rises To Top
scenarios.trigger: If the higher-rated newcomers show their breeding and handle debut conditions
scenarios.body: Mistress Of Tyrone or Premier Princess could overcome their inexperience with superior ability, tracking the pace before challenging. The soft ground may not inconvenience well-bred types as much as exposed runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Proven Form Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Chasing Paradise or Chablis Rock benefit from the strong pace and get the perfect trip
scenarios.body: Their previous placed efforts give them a form edge, and both could improve stepping up in distance. However, their hold-up styles face the challenge of making up ground on testing turf.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Totally Puzzled stops quickly and the race becomes a sprint from the turn
scenarios.body: A wall of hold-up horses could suddenly find themselves in contention if the leader fades dramatically. This would require multiple horses to find significant improvement simultaneously.

races.paceDynamic: Faiyum, California Dreamer and Moments Of Joy will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with all three capable of taking the field along at a searching pace over this stamina-testing mile. The prominent brigade of She's A Nation, Bubble Gum, Celestial Orbit, Cameo and Spicy Margarita creates congestion behind the leaders, setting up potential traffic problems turning for home. With soft ground adding to the stamina demands and three confirmed front-runners guaranteeing no let-up in pace, this setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and finish with one sustained run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a genuine gallop and the prominent group gets bunched up
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest throughout and the field will string out, allowing the hold-up horses clean runs to pick off tired leaders. Princess Child and Catalina Delcarpio can time their challenges perfectly from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an uncontested lead and quickens off steady fractions
scenarios.body: Faiyum or California Dreamer could steal a march if the other speed horses are tactical, getting first run on the field before the closers can respond. The class horse survives the late challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Raider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early and becomes stop-start with tactical racing
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses held up prominently get first run on both the spent leaders and the hold-up horses still in rear. Bubble Gum's stamina and class could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Completely Falls Apart
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners are surprisingly restrained and nobody wants the lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no true pace, favouring horses with tactical speed who can quicken sharply. Any of the prominent racers could capitalise on the lack of early pace.

races.paceDynamic: Dar Toungi is the sole confirmed front runner in this 21-runner handicap and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead given the lack of other pace pressers. The large field with predominantly prominent and hold-up horses will create a tactical affair with jockeys reluctant to commit early, allowing Dar Toungi to control the fractions. The soft going and mile distance will test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs as the field compacts behind the leader. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and hold-up horses with a turn of foot — the sustainable early pace will leave plenty in reserve for a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the field sits off Dar Toungi and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The patient tactics allow closers like Westminster Moon, Gleneagle Bay and Final Voyage to unleash late kicks. Seamie Heffernan on Westminster Moon and David Egan on Gleneagle Bay have the class to time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy horses gets first run on the field
scenarios.body: Iron Fist, Independent Expert or Perry Mason can capitalize on their ideal position behind Dar Toungi to strike before the hold-up brigade arrives. Shane Foley's 2-from-10 record on soft going with Iron Fist suggests strong stable confidence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Dar Toungi sets unsustainably slow fractions in the large field
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to quicken clear and steal the race, with other prominent runners like Dos Mukasan and Diego El Queso benefiting from the moderate gallop. Gerard O'Leary's recent winner with Dos Mukasan indicates the stable is in form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If the field goes too slow and bunches for a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The soft ground and sustained sprint from the back becomes a lottery where any horse can win on the day. Playin Cool and Lady Lilac could emerge from the pack with their proven soft ground form.

races.paceDynamic: Norwalk Havoc is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from flag to finish, with the Joseph O'Brien trio (Glen To Glen, Starford, Comfort Zone) likely to track in second and third positions alongside Eastwatch and Immutable. With 16 of the 20 runners adopting hold-up tactics, the early gallop will be measured rather than punishing, allowing Norwalk Havoc to bowl along comfortably without serious pressure until the home turn. The field will bunch up approaching the straight as the hold-up brigade fan out for their runs, creating a cavalry charge finish over the final two furlongs. This setup moderately favours prominent racers and early hold-up horses who can secure good positions turning in — those coming from the back of this 20-runner field will need significant luck in running on soft ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Norwalk Havoc Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Norwalk Havoc dictates an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Shane Foley can dictate fractions from the front and has the class edge with an RPR of 110, while the chasing pack will struggle to peg back a horse in the form of his life. The Mrs Harrington stable is in excellent form and this front-runner has won four times already.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Eastwatch and Glen To Glen track Norwalk Havoc closely and outfinish him in the straight.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the traffic problems that will plague the hold-up horses in this large field, with both possessing the tactical speed to strike decisively. Andrew Slattery rides Eastwatch with stable confidence while Glen To Glen has winning form at the trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and allows a classy hold-up horse to produce a sweeping late run.
scenarios.body: Coeur d'Or returns from a break for the master trainer David Weld with Chris Hayes aboard, suggesting connections expect a big run despite the long layoff. The veteran's class could prove decisive if he gets the right race setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Norwalk Havoc ties up dramatically and multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously in a blanket finish.
scenarios.body: The sheer weight of numbers from the back could overwhelm the early leaders if the pace is too steady, with Ribee's recent winning form and Starford's class making them dangerous finishers. However, this scenario requires significant pace mismanagement.

watchPoints.text: Norwalk Havoc must be watched for any signs of over-racing early as the sole leader in this large field could face pressure to go too fast
The Joseph O'Brien trio of Glen To Glen, Starford and Comfort Zone need monitoring as they could work against each other if tracking too closely
